title: Approximate tangent space implies Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_ρ(x))/ρⁿ → ω_n (Simon Ch. 3 Remark 1.5(3); parent Step 7)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set, x ∈ ℝ^N and P ⊆ ℝ^N a linear subspace. Assume Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_δ(x)) < ∞ for some δ > 0, and that M has approximate tangent space P at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3 Def. 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x P: dim P = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_P f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ)). Here Hⁿ = μHE[n] and η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x). Then Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_ρ(x))/ρⁿ → ω_n := Lⁿ(B_1(0)) in [0, ∞] as ρ ↓ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), (∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ μHE[n] (M ∩ Metric.closedBall x δ) < ∞) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x P → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μHE[n] (M ∩ Metric.closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)))
